title: Energizing Filipino Fish Skewers
description: A pungent and crumbly Filipino dish featuring fines-herbes and miso-marinate, perfect for pescatarians looking for a flavorful and energizing meal.

ingredients.name: fines-herbes
ingredients.notes: mix of parsley, dill, and chives

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine miso paste, fines-herbes, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the marinade.
Place the fish fillets in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them, making sure they are fully coated.
Let the fish marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated fish onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Season the fish with salt and black pepper.
Grill the fish skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the fish skewers hot, garnished with additional fines-herbes if desired.
Let the fish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
